title: Market like a team of ten
description: Learn from your best posts, hear what people say about you, watch competitors, and turn one idea into content for every channel. Free to download.
introduction: Marketing teams are small and the to-do list isn't. There's always one more report to pull, one more competitor to check, and one more post for a channel you forgot about.
Strawberry works inside your analytics, social accounts, CMS, and the live web, so it does the digging and the drafting with real numbers in front of it. It makes the images too.

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Strawberry is free to download. Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

sections.title: Find out why your best posts worked

blocks.text: Point Strawberry at a year of your posts. It finds the ones that did best, works out what they have in common, and turns that into a brief for the next ones.

demo.prompt: Which of our LinkedIn posts did best this year, and why?
steps: Top 10% all opened with a customer story

sections.title: Hear what people say about you

blocks.text: Reviews, Reddit threads, LinkedIn comments, and forums, read in the browser and turned into a report or a deck in your brand, with a link to every quote.

demo.prompt: What are people saying about us online this month?

blocks.text: Pricing pages, changelogs, ads, and job posts say a lot about where a competitor is heading. A Routine checks them and tells you what changed and what it means for you.

demo.title: Competitor watch
steps: Rival raised prices 20% on the Pro plan

sections.title: One idea, content for every channel

blocks.text: Give Strawberry a talk, a launch, or a long post. It turns it into versions for LinkedIn, X, email, and the blog in your voice, with generated images where a stock photo would have gone.

demo.prompt: Turn our launch blog post into posts for LinkedIn, X, and the newsletter
steps: Read the post and your brand guide

blocks.text: Strawberry works inside Search Console and your analytics while you're logged in, checks the live results, and brings back a short list of fixes in order of impact.

demo.prompt: Why did our organic traffic drop last month?
steps: Compared Search Console month over month
3 pricing pages lost their top positions

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: A chatbot writes from a blank page. Strawberry writes from your numbers.

items: It reads your analytics, social accounts, and CMS while you are logged in.
It checks the live web across many pages at once.
It generates images to go with the copy.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Plan a campaign from what's already in your analytics and past launches.
Review last month and decide what to change.
Build a list of high-fit accounts for a campaign.
Turn research into a beautiful deck in your brand.

blocks.text: Your brand voice, audience notes, and what worked last quarter shouldn't live in one person's head. Keep them in the team workspace and every companion writes the same way.
Put the weekly numbers and the competitor check on Routines, and Monday starts with a short summary instead of four dashboards.
